scope: Replace read-only candidate evaluation with a private one-step KDA successor calculation. Real memory is never modified by candidates. Compare measured-only writes with legally propagated retained-track pseudomeasurements; no predictor, extra gate, new reward or privileged observations. All original current-value and vanilla-read references are unchanged; retain the strongest completed context-GRU reference rather than the weaker V4 GRU.
sensor: 360-degree centre-ray human-body occlusion; no range cutoff or random dropout
association: Ideal association of previously visible actors; identity is not a numeric model input
primary: Success rate in unseen 10/20-person populations, equally weighted; 5-person SR is a robustness check
checkpoint_selection: Final fixed-budget checkpoint only; IL snapshot is diagnostic
allowed_revision: A hypothetical successor evaluation is not an observed-history write. Test this inherited value-lookahead contract before assuming read-only retrieval is appropriate. The two new KDA arms have identical parameters and initialization; their sole difference is whether legal CV frames are accepted as real-history pseudomeasurements. Old references require full configuration/budget checks and checkpoint/controller parity before reuse. Fresh confirmation must train all arms on unseen seeds, not reuse development controls.
